# Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime

- Runtime source: the x64 Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable, version 14.51.36247.0.
- The setup bundle uses the unmodified app-local DLLs from the matching `vcRuntimeMinimum_amd64` CAB. The official installer signature and file versions are checked by `build.py`.
- Microsoft license terms are included as `Visual-C-Runtime-2015-2022-License.docx`.
- Microsoft redistribution list: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution
- Microsoft runtime guidance: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files
- Download: https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x64.exe
